exact_claim: Does the exact3x6 minus2x2 corner14-omino admit a finite rectangular tiling by an odd number of congruent copies, with rotations/reflections allowed and no independent scaling? Distinguish arbitrary Euclidean placements from a justified grid reduction, and rectangular tiling from self-replication.
